Subject: Interactive pilot session — scheduling, networking allowlist & staging checklist

Hi Sarah —

Thanks for the time last week. We recommend a 90-minute interactive pilot so your engineers can run sample prompts, test routing rules, and execute a short load burst on staging. High-level options:

- Option A: Wed 18 Aug, 10:00–11:30 PT (preferred)
- Option B: Thu 19 Aug, 14:00–15:30 PT

Before the session we need a few items so the team can onboard quickly:
1) A staging API key or allowlist range for 44.33.12.0/24 (we can accept IP or VPC peering)
2) Sandbox service account for push/pull with limited data
3) Staging endpoint URL and any auth proxy details
4) A couple representative prompts to sanity-check inference routing and token limits

I've attached a one-page interactive checklist. If either slot works, I'll send a calendar invite and a one-hour prep meeting for your infra folks.

Best,
Michael
Michael Grant | Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Perfect — thanks for the clarification on peering. Novacare team, next steps from our side:

1) We’ll request a VPC peering connection to your staging VPC (VPC ID: redwood-staging). Please share the VPC ID and preferred account for peering.
2) If peering isn’t possible, we’ll provide three host IPs for allowlisting: 35.201.11.42, 35.201.11.43, 35.201.11.44 (these are our session egress IPs; please whitelist inbound on port 443).
3) Monica will upload the load test script (novacare-loadtest-plan.yaml) to the shared Drive and will run the 50-concurrent short request burst during minute 45 of the session.
4) Sarah — when you confirm the VPC ID or whitelist the three IPs we’ll send a calendar invite for Wed 18 Aug, 11:30–13:00 PT and a 30-minute infra prep call on Tue 17 Aug at 09:00 PT.

Attachments: redwood-interactive-checklist.pdf (one-page checklist), novacare-loadtest-plan.yaml (load test config stub)

Thanks — looking forward to it.
